description: process_create compares send_at_str > now_str as lexicographic strings. This is only correct for UTC timestamps in exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ form. A well-formed RFC 3339 timestamp with a +00:00 offset, fractional seconds, or a different zone will produce an incorrect comparison, either silently accepting a timestamp that exceeds maxDelayedSend or rejecting a valid future time. The comment does not warn about this fragility.
title: sendAt future-time check uses string comparison, breaks on non-UTC RFC 3339
